exposure: response to rescue inhaled nitric oxide (iNO) therapy
outcome: survival without moderate-to-severe disability at 18 months of age
reduction in fraction of inspired oxygen (FiO2)
cohort: The study included 89 preterm neonates less than 35 weeks gestational age with severe acute pulmonary hypertension who received rescue inhaled nitric oxide therapy.
finding: A positive response to rescue inhaled nitric oxide in preterm infants with acute severe pulmonary hypertension is associated with improved survival and without long-term disability.
